title: EEE-Bench: A Comprehensive Multimodal Electrical And Electronics Engineering Benchmark

model.params_source: paper Appendix E, Table 5, row GPT-4V ('model': 'gpt-4-turbo', temperature 0, max tokens 1024); top_p assumed

task.subset_rule: all (test split; the release also has a 572-item testmini)
task.approximation: Single run instead of the paper's average of two runs; answer extraction with gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 and the MathVista extraction prompt (the paper's 'exemplary system prompt' is not printed); image detail default; free-form items scored by answer type.

items.config_or_split: default / test (2,860 rows verified; features image, problem, solution)

fields_paper.input: problem (already prefixed with the Table 4 task instruction as 'Hint: ...' followed by 'Question: ...' and the choices)
fields_paper.label: solution

placeholders.image: items.image attached as an image content part (not expressible)

prompt.source_location: Table 4 (task instructions per answer type) and Appendix C.3 (instruction header prepended to each question, following MathVista); Sec. 3.1 'Evaluation'
prompt.verbatim: full (the release stores the Table 4 header inside the problem field)

placeholders_paper.problem: items.input verbatim (release field; equals the Table 4 instruction for the item's answer type + question + choices, MathVista style)
placeholders_paper.image: items.image attached as an image content part

output.postprocess: MathVista normalization: strip, letter match, numeric comparison by answer type (Float(1)/(2)/(3), Integer, List)
output.parse_paper: free text -> extracted answer by the judge; letter for multiple-choice, number/list for free-form

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: share of the 2,860 items whose extracted answer matches solution
metric.judge: llm:gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, prompt: MathVista answer-extraction prompt (Lu et al. 2023, MathVista repo prompts/ext_ans.py) per the resolution plan

cost.prepare_note: not prepared (source gated / archive / unreachable / >100 MB)

open_points: no hook: every item needs its image as an image_url content part (the test parquet is ~133 MB of images, above the 100 MB limit) and the runner builds text-only messages.
answer extraction by an LLM judge (gpt-4o-mini, unpinned alias, MathVista prompt) plus type-aware numeric comparison would need a judge stage written against that alias.
notes: Per-subject columns (EMag 44.12 ... ED 48.86) allow a subject-level check if the release carries a subject field (only image/problem/solution were visible).
